immudb.api_profile: schema.ImmuService native gRPC; full dual/linear-advance/inclusion proofs

deployment_prerequisites: Operator-built SDK binary, reviewed go.sum and pinned binary SHA256
Existing TLS NATS account, JetStream file-backed bounded stream and pull durable consumer
Native Tessera add/tiles deployment behind authenticated HTTPS; signed log checkpoint and independent witness quorum
Existing immudb database/account/TLS, pinned server UUID and ECDSA state-signing public key
Operator-approved initial checkpoints/state; callback credentials; protected DPAPI/keyring storage
explicit_limits: No broker/IdP/log/database is manufactured by this bridge
No transport notification creates or dispatches SENTRA Run/WorkItem/Operation/grant
PubAck does not prove an executed machine effect
Inclusion and signed state do not prove complete effect coverage
No speculative resend after lost append/transaction response
Transaction export supports one-entry audit records and does not restore all SENTRA artifacts
